tasks.label: 1. Create ZFS
tasks.command: zowe zos-files create zos-file-system ${input:zfsName} --cyls-pri 500 --cyls-sec 140 --group ZWEADMIN --owner ZWESVUSR --perms 777 --timeout 300 --response-timeout 300

tasks.label: 3. Mount File System
tasks.command: zowe zos-files mount file-system ${input:zfsName} ${input:directory} --fs-type ZFS --mode rdwr
